protocol.question: Full-pool actual trend exits and worst-case inspection; no new fitting or strategy changes.
protocol.fitting: Each ETF's sealed independently fitted entry/risk anchor. Fixed21/1 exit control, not individually selected exit. All104 later training selections retained the existing exit.
protocol.ranking: All51 risky ETFs x2 domains, including inadequate-training rows with flags; BIL cash reference excluded from rankings. Worst net cumulative, largest change vs existing fit and largest gap vs buy-hold are separate descriptive ranks. Focus is two worst losses and largest deterioration.
protocol.inspection: Replay104 later actual-control and104 baseline paths. Independent least-squares support reconstruction, ledger and exact log accounting. Earlier metrics and all six frictions are verified saved evidence. No new portfolio experiment; prior study retains dynamic/monthly controls. Post-result inspection is not a selection rule.
protocol.authority: Research only, previously inspected history. No promotion, deployment or allocation changes.
